name: fify
description: Turn grounded AI answers into trusted interactive information views.

interface.shortDescription: Turn complex answers into interactive views.
interface.longDescription: Ask normally or tag @Fify. Turn grounded answers into catalog-constrained comparisons, plans, checklists, timelines, decision tools, and editable summaries while preserving the complete ordinary answer as an authoritative fallback. No end-user API key, Fify account, or schema knowledge is required.
defaultPrompt: Turn this answer into an interactive comparison I can filter.
Make this rollout plan a checklist I can work through.
Show these milestones as a timeline with risks and next steps.
